source_ids=set(re.findall(r'^## (CASE-\d+)$',source,re.M))
lines=findings.splitlines()
found=[re.match(r'^- (CASE-\d+) — .+$',line) for line in lines]
assert len(source_ids)==180
assert len(lines)==8 and all(found)
ids=[m.group(1) for m in found]
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids)) and set(ids)<=source_ids
print(f'Validated {len(lines)} unique findings against {len(source_ids)} source cases.')
